prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original photorealistic artistic interpretation of Torrent de Pareis at Sa Calobra, Mallorca, at true night. Eye-level viewpoint standing on the public pale pebble beach at the gorge mouth, looking INLAND, not aerial and not toward open sea. Symmetrical but natural canyon composition: two enormous sheer fractured limestone walls rise from left and right edges and narrow sharply toward a dark slot in the center distance; orange-grey stratified rock with sparse low scrub; pale rounded pebbles and mostly dry gravel fill lower foreground with a narrow darker drainage channel, but no invented lagoon, waterfall, flash flood or tide claim. Real rugged Mediterranean gorge, no tropical palms, no buildings, tunnels, roads, railings or lamps. Frame cliff tops with sky margin; central slot and beach remain recognizable in4:5 crop. Restrained long-exposure ambient interpretation: almost-black sky with no moon, stars, Milky Way or twilight; cliffs barely but clearly legible in cool neutral darkness, no directional spotlight, no orange sunset light. No people, tents, umbrellas, boats, animals, text, logo or watermark. Original scene, not copying a photograph. Lower20% quiet pebbles reserved for later captions.
